title: The Farmer and His Sons
summary: An aging farmer told his lazy sons that a great treasure lay buried in their vineyard....
full_text:
An aging farmer told his lazy sons that a great treasure lay buried in their vineyard.

After his death, the sons dug up every foot of the vineyard with spades, searching for gold.

They found no coins, but the loosened soil produced a magnificent harvest of grapes that made them wealthy, teaching them that industry is the true treasure.
moral: Honest toil in the earth is the truest gold a father can bequeath.
